newsitem.title: USA: No role in negotiating rail merger-U.S. Board head.
newsitem.headline: No role in negotiating rail merger-U.S. Board head.

text.p: The chairman of the U.S. Surface Transportation Board, Linda Morgan, said on Wednesday that the board had no role in negotiating mergers and only acted once a merger proposal was filed.

Morgan had no comment on the specifics of the CSX Corp /Norfolk Southern Corp effort to acquire Conrail, but said whatever proposal came before the board would be judged on its competitive merits and other standards.
She told Reuters by telephone that in past mergers, the two sides had negotiated concessions before they submitted a merger proposal to make the deal more equitable.

In some cases, Morgan said, the board added its own conditions to the proposal to assure it not only maintained a competitive balance but also that it was fair to shippers, railroad workers and the general public.
